Most items bought from Samsung.com or through the Shop Samsung App can be returned within 15 days of delivery . After you request a return, you have another 15 days to ship the product back . Return shipping is free, but some products carry a restocking fee of up to 15% . Anything that arrives damaged, defective, or non-functioning must be reported within 5 days of delivery or 2 days after installation , whichever is later. Products bought from other retailers must be returned to that retailer, under their own policy. Products picked up at a partner retailer have different return policies.
